outline.en: Start: greet everyone and say your topic.
Point 1: say where the place is and what it looks like.
Point 2: say what you do there, or what happened there once.
Point 3: say why you love it.

model: Good morning, everyone. My name is Kiran.
Today, I am going to talk about my favourite place.
It is the big mango tree behind our school.
It is taller than all the other trees, and its shade is cool.
Every day, my friends and I eat our lunch under it.
Last summer, we were reading stories there when a monkey stole a mango!
I love this place because it is peaceful and full of friends.
